nodes.title: FULL SONG — generated motion + source lights + title + EQ
RUN THIS OUTPUT — preview detected lights

widgets_values: Locked camera and exact source composition. Preserve all people, faces, bodies, architecture, symbols, text, objects, framing, colors, identity, exposure, brightness, and contrast. Where present, thick smoke, fog, mist, and clouds roll, curl, and billow dynamically in multiple independent layers while retaining their original color and texture. Water surfaces ripple and surge naturally. Hair and loose fabric flow in a steady breeze. Flags and hanging banners wave naturally. Chains sway slightly. Tentacles or organic appendages wriggle subtly in place. Other environmental motion may be restrained and physically plausible. Keep lights spatially fixed; music-synchronized glow and flicker are added later by the compositor. Strong atmospheric motion, crisp stable structures, stable geometry, stable camera, seamless-loop-friendly pacing.
